of the norm ratio, if the function norm has a unique maximizer and a nonzero
non-root derivative maximizer is available, at most one distinct root position
can be strictly exterior. Multiple function-norm maximizers invalidate the
single-active-point stationarity equation. They occur even in the exact
quadratic examples. No equioscillation, compactness, remaining-one-exterior-root,
or strictness argument closes the full problem.
